method: New nominations from BDFutbol 1999-00 team league statistics, FootballSquads contemporary squad records and PFA awards. Existing Archive candidate list not used as input. Positions and DOBs are working hypotheses pending full per-player cross-check; grades only on evidence-supported subset. Ranks are subset only.

clubTactics.chelsea: 4-4-2; Poyet narrow left, Zola second striker
clubTactics.astonvilla: 3-5-2 / alternative 4-4-2; Barry third CB and Wright/Delaney wingbacks hypothesis

notes: Three-back CB third starter recorded as backup for archive cap, not actual bench role; Villa and Leicester have ten nominal starters in archive mapping.
Leeds Robinson 0 league appearances excluded; no eligible backup GK identified.
Guppy and Impey wingbacks; tactical assignments otherwise provisional.
Dates are reference transcriptions, not all independently verified; Ian Marshall DOB not confirmed.
No full 3-season evidence; null tiers not filled by reputation or minutes alone.
No existing approved data overwritten. Best XI not integrated until independent pool fully graded.
